scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Inspect the complete schema contract
cases.input_contract: Return ordered field triples(name, simpleString, nullable) for a DataFrame. Check the fixture rather than inferring correctness from a printed schema alone.
cases.expected: The triples are(event_id, bigint, false),(team, string, true),(amount_cents, bigint, true).
cases.verification: Compare the complete triples with literals in both languages, including all nullability flags.

cases.title: Keep a transformation separate from its action
cases.input_contract: Return a DataFrame plan selecting team A without collecting or counting inside the function. At the call site, request a count and verify IDs 1 and 3. Preserve raw.
cases.expected: The returned frame contains two rows when evaluated;raw still has four. The function body contains only a filter transformation.
cases.verification: Assert returned count 2, ordered IDs[1,3] and raw count 4 at explicit action sites.

cases.title: Bound the driver result and detect overflow of the budget
cases.input_contract: Return ordered event IDs while collecting at most limit+1 rows, with 0<=limit<=20. Reject a result larger than limit and invalid limits. Empty data with limit 0 is valid. Do not collect the full frame before checking length.
cases.expected: The four-row fixture passes limit 4 and rejects limit 3. An empty filter with limit 0 returns empty;limit 21 is rejected before collection.
cases.verification: Assert exact IDs, catch the oversize and invalid-budget errors, and inspect the bounded limit before the action.

cases.title: Retain observed zero while isolating unknown amounts
cases.input_contract: Return rows with nonnull amount_cents, keeping all columns and identities. Do not replace NULL with zero or filter out observed zero.
cases.expected: IDs 1,3,4 remain with amounts 0,25,40, total 65. Raw still has one NULL amount at ID 2.
cases.verification: Assert exact IDs and sum 65, and independently count the unchanged raw NULL row.

cases.title: Canonicalize content across physical repartitioning
cases.input_contract: Return ordered triples(event_id, optional team, optional amount) for this bounded fixture. Compare raw, repartition(1) and repartition(3) against the same literal content, not raw collect order.
cases.expected: Every version yields (1, A,0),(2, B, NULL),(3, A,25),(4, B,40). Physical placement does not change identity, NULL state or value.
cases.verification: Assert all three canonical outputs and keep the final event_id ordering explicit.

cases.title: Read back the actual local session contract
cases.input_contract: Return master, timezone, shuffle-partition, ANSI, AQE, UI, driver-binding and Spark-version settings from the active session. Compare them with this prepared profile and rely on finally for owned stop. Do not substitute a hardcoded target string for version readback.
cases.expected: Master local[2], UTC, two shuffle partitions, ANSI true, AQE false, UI false, both driver addresses 127.0.0.1, and Spark version 4.0.1.
cases.verification: Assert the complete settings map;record actual version output and distinguish it from worker cleanup evidence.
